title: Sources: Nikita Kucherov tells Lightning he won't re-sign, asks for trade
text:
Sources: Nikita Kucherov tells Lightning he won't re-sign, asks for trade - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Sources: Nikita Kucherov tells Lightning he won't re-sign, asks for trade
 Elliotte Friedman @FriedgeHNIC October 31, 2026 - 1:32am Elliotte Friedman joins Jesse Fuchs to discuss the ins and outs of Nikita Kucherov's shocking trade request, where the breakdown with the Lightning organization happened, how he delivered the news to the team, and more. 
 Well, here’s a Friday-afternoon whopper:
 According to multiple sources, Nikita Kucherov has informed both his teammates and the Lightning organization that he will not be re-signing with Tampa Bay and would like to be traded.
 The exact reasons are unclear at this point, but Kucherov — the NHL’s reigning MVP — is in the final season of an eight-year, $76-million contract. Last week, he passed Steven Stamkos as the leading scorer in franchise history.
 Lightning GM Julien BriseBois released a statement later on Friday night.
 "We are aware of the media reports regarding the future of Nikita Kucherov with the Lightning," the statement from Brisebois reads. "We unequivocally have no intention of trading Nikita."
 Dan Milstein, Kucherov’s agent, declined to comment.
 For most of us, Kucherov staying in Tampa seemed like an absolute certainty. Obviously, we were wrong about that. Who knows where we go by the trade deadline and July 1, but Kucherov has made it clear he is not happy and, at this time, prefers another path.
 More as this story develops.
